description.es:
Video de "Planet Earth", pieza instrumental de ecamhi publicada en su canal el 27 de octubre de 2020, el mismo día que "Not My Birthday". A octubre de 2026 el canal no tiene otros videos: son los primeros registros audiovisuales del proyecto solista de Enrique Camhi, trompetista y productor de Newen Afrobeat. La descripción solo remite a su SoundCloud y no aporta datos sobre la imagen; las etiquetas del video hablan de beats, lo-fi, ambient y trompeta.

El tema dura 2:48 y es anterior a "Fake Love" (2021), su primer registro oficial en plataformas, y a "Move To" (2022). Muestra la línea de beatmaking con trompeta que la bio del artista describe como su propuesta instrumental y electrónica.

Es la entrada más temprana al universo de ecamhi, previa al EP "en viaje" que prepara con PHŌNÉ Records.
description.en:
Video for "Planet Earth", an instrumental piece by ecamhi published on his channel on October 27, 2020, the same day as "Not My Birthday". As of October 2026 the channel has no other videos: they are the first audiovisual records of the solo project of Enrique Camhi, trumpet player and producer with Newen Afrobeat. The description only points to his SoundCloud and gives no details about the picture; the video's tags mention beats, lo-fi, ambient and trumpet.

The track runs 2:48 and predates "Fake Love" (2021), his first official release on streaming platforms, and "Move To" (2022). It shows the trumpet-and-beatmaking line that the artist's bio describes as his instrumental and electronic proposal.

It is the earliest entry into ecamhi's universe, prior to the EP "en viaje" he is preparing with PHŌNÉ Records.
